content.text: You’re a designer in Lagos, Nairobi, or Karachi. You’ve built a library of fonts, templates, and presets. But Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad aren’t options. Local [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you|payment]] gateways fail at scale. Crypto is your only reliable payment rail—but how do you accept it without depending on exchanges or wallets? This is the infrastructure problem. The solution is not a workaround. It’s a sovereign commerce stack: your own digital storefront, automatic crypto payment verification, and instant file delivery. No platforms. No subscriptions. Full ownership.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

A sovereign commerce stack is a combination of tools that let you sell digital products directly to customers, using crypto payments, without relying on third-party platforms. For design assets like fonts, templates, or presets, this means no Gumroad fees (10% per sale), no PayPal restrictions, and no Stripe rejections. Instead, you use [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-what-9|COREMERCH guide to github]] Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-6|Cloudflare Webhook-Driven]] Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. The customer pays in USDT, BTC, or any of 300+ cryptocurrencies. The moment payment confirms on-chain, the file delivers. You retain 99.5% of every sale. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, that’s $921 more in your pocket than Gumroad.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack is divided into three layers: hosting, payment verification, and file delivery. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally fast. Payment verification uses NOWPayments, which listens for on-chain transactions and fires a webhook when payment confirms. Backend logic (checking payment status, triggering file delivery) runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Files are stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. When a customer completes payment, the webhook triggers the script, which generates a temporary download link and emails it to the buyer. No databases required for basic setups. No servers to manage. The entire system is stateless and serverless.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, or software in Nigeria, Pakistan, Venezuela, or Zimbabwe, this stack gives you infrastructure sovereignty. It’s also for creators who refuse to pay platform fees or rent access to their own customers. With this architecture, you own the storefront, the payment logic, and the delivery mechanism. Customers pay directly to your crypto wallet. No intermediaries. No KYC. No buyer accounts required. The system is designed to work even in environments with unstable currencies or internet connectivity.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction—95% less than Gumroad’s 10% fee.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments and triggers webhooks. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 stores your files. Supabase or Google Sheets can store order data if needed. The key integration is between NOWPayments and your backend script. NOWPayments sends a webhook when payment confirms. The script checks the payment ID, generates a download link, and emails it to the customer. All components are free or low-cost. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. Cloudflare Workers is free for low usage. GitHub Pages and Google Drive are free. The only cost is your time to deploy—or $197 for the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all blueprints and templates.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your hosting platform: GitHub Pages for simplicity or Cloudflare Pages for edge performance. Set up NOWPayments to accept your preferred cryptocurrencies (USDT on BSC, TRON, or Solana for low fees). Write the backend logic in Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment verification and file delivery. Test the flow end-to-end: simulate a payment, verify the webhook fires, and confirm the file delivers. Load your products into the system. Launch. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints, templates, and scaling guides. Available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Deploy in 48 hours. Own your infrastructure.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, use a sovereign commerce stack. Host your storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Accept crypto payments through NOWPayments (0.5% fee). Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to verify payments and deliver files. Store files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This architecture gives you full control over your sales process, eliminates platform fees, and works globally—even in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable.
The stack is stateless: no databases, no servers, no customer data stored.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re selling notion templates for USDT or building a crypto-only digital download store, the principles are the same. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates for deploying sovereign commerce stacks. Available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Whether you’re selling fonts in Karachi or courses in Lagos, this kit gives you the tools to own your infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up NOWPayments to accept your preferred cryptocurrencies. Write backend logic in Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Test payment verification and file delivery end-to-end. Load your products into the system. Configure email delivery for download links. Deploy your storefront. Monitor transaction fees—use BSC, Solana, or TRON for sub-$0.10 transactions. Scale by adding more products or integrating Supabase for order storage. Own your stack.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step blueprints and templates. Deploy in 48 hours with no coding required. Available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept for low fees?
Use USDT on BSC, Solana, or TRON. Transaction fees are under $0.10. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, but these networks are optimized for low-cost transactions.
Do I need to store customer data?
No. The system is stateless. Payments verify on-chain. Files deliver via temporary links. If you want to track orders, use Supabase or Google Sheets—but it’s optional.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are manual. Since payments go directly to your wallet, you control refunds. Document your policy clearly. Use a separate wallet for store revenue to track transactions.
Can I scale this to thousands of sales per month?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing. For higher volume, integrate Supabase for order storage and use Cloudflare Workers for backend logic.
Deploy in 48 hours. Own your infrastructure. Never rent access to your customers.
